integrity: The complete group law and fixed-subset proof is embedded with two self-contained Python standard-library verification programs. One checks actual coordinate arithmetic over three finite-field examples; the other exhausts the 296010 subsets of a universal 27-element torsion model. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fermat plane cubic over finite fields of characteristic at least five only; includes all six-distinct-point conics but does not classify intersections of conics away from the sextactic divisor, twists, or the special characteristics two and three. Geometric totals 27, 81, 8244, 5976 and 2268 were previously known; the claimed new contribution is finite-field Frobenius descent, exact rational smooth-conic counts and all arithmetic cycles.
title: Arithmetic descent of sextactic conics and trisecants of the Fermat cubic
